title: bug: every fresh publish reads UNKNOWN, and is offered the operator's Resolve, while its one push is still in flight
description:
Found by worker-952c612b during task-21be6e9055984413a651ce6ee331e2c8's adversarial review. Evidence is code only: no probe was run.

WHY THE WINDOW EXISTS. node-publisher.ts:186-189 journals the intent BEFORE its one push (:202). run-goal-publication.ts:13 calls any intent with no receipt UNKNOWN. affordance-read answers `unknownPublishDecision` from that same read, so affordance-planning-offers.ts:255 mints repository.publish_resolve. Result: for the seconds between the intent commit and the post-push receipt, the Publish card shows UNKNOWN and the Resolve buttons.

WHAT A CLICK IN THAT WINDOW DOES.
1. The operator's NOT_TRANSMITTED or ABANDON records the REFUSED receipt first. recordPublishReceipt keeps the first writer: publish-ledger.ts:203-204.
2. If the push lands, the publisher's PUSHED write gets that REFUSED receipt back. It reports UNKNOWN "remote holds the sha but the recorded receipt does not match the candidate" (:217-219).
3. On the next pass it gives the hold back as PUBLISH_RESOLVED.
4. The card then says REFUSED while the remote holds the commit.
The cost is bounded: a later decision's push of the same sha is a git no-op, and a remote that has moved on is refused PUBLISH_REMOTE_DIVERGED by the pre-flight. So the effect is not transmitted twice, but the record is wrong.

HINT FOR THE FIX, left to the architect. A live controller does NOT tell in-flight from stuck: a stuck publish's hold is also owned by the live wrapper. The fix must also keep a publish that was stuck before task-78dea88b resolvable; such a publish has no transmission record. publish-resolve-journey.test.ts's step (4) pins the card at UNKNOWN for a stuck publish.
definitionOfDone: While a fresh publish's single push is in flight (intent journaled, no receipt), the card does not say UNKNOWN and the affordance read offers no repository.publish_resolve. A test pins this against the production read and the production offer mint.
A stuck UNKNOWN publish is still offered the resolve. This includes one stuck before task-78dea88b, which has no transmission record. publish-resolve-journey.test.ts stays green.
